summary: Threat model for arc-011: 13 trust boundaries with the full STRIDE matrix plus confused deputy, approved-not-executed, replay and break-glass; 57 threats; adversaries ADV-1..ADV-10 with privileges plus three proposed (rogue hub, unadmitted joiner, network attacker); circuit trust model with credential lifetime options (recommend 1 h); same-id and same-sequence-number rules by content digest and signature; peer-content framing and doorbell invariants; fleet admission by roster and signed cards; revocation; durability scope; evidence producers; bypass inventory BP-1..BP-19; 28 testable security invariants; 14 residual risks one per line; 13 change requests to step 1; 11 decisions for the operator. Key finding: all agents on a host share one OS user, so per-agent keys give attribution and stop remote attackers but not a malicious same-host process (RR-2). The requirements document was not changed.

open_questions: 12.3 whether the hub copy of a circuit turn carries content (CR-9)
1.3.b this project has no design-render-check.py or role-handback-check.py: render check done with mmdc, hand-back validated against the schema only

change_requests.what: CR-1 R-45.a conflicts with R-7.e (1): stages cannot be written to the hub first when the hub is unreachable on a circuit. Add a local hash-chained log first, replayed on return.
CR-2 No requirement says messages are signed by a per-agent key and verified (GP-1; R-34.e (2) says authentication is not required, R-63 relies on a verified key). Add one.
CR-3 R-51.a: identity should be (sender key, conversation id, message id) bound to a content digest, with a CONFLICT outcome for the same id with different content.
CR-4 R-59.a: receipts signed, forward-only and bounded by what was stored; random first number; counter rebuilt from the hub record; equivocation outcome.
CR-5 R-23.a and R-23.e: make 'no peer content in the typed line' firm, constrain ids to 32 hex characters, require a foreground-process check before typing.
CR-6 R-50 and R-47: frame produced by the receiving adapter with a random boundary, a size cap, no peer message as approval, applied to every rail that puts peer text in an agent's context.
CR-7 R-46: add the sender-constrained, channel-bound, scoped credential, lifetime on the verifier's monotonic clock, revocation list, and a stated lifetime.
CR-8 R-60 and R-61: fleet admission roster, signed cards with sequence and time-to-live, home-hub binding, hub signing key apart from the TLS certificate.
CR-9 R-35, R-45, R-15: say whether the hub copy of a circuit turn carries content, and whether content is protected from the hub operator.
CR-10 R-63.a: the default allow-list 'own project plus the operator' has no authenticated operator identity until GP-11 is ruled.
CR-11 R-53.a and R-63: peers should see only reachable yes or no and the version class, not the four reachability fields.
CR-12 R-65.a and R-60: DEAD must be signed, and a resume or takeover needs a host-local check that no process holds the session.
CR-13 R-67.a and R-64: role eligibility must come from operator-signed configuration, and grants and allow-lists must be stored where the limited agent cannot write.

decisions_needed: OQ-1 confirm adversaries ADV-11 rogue hub, ADV-12 unadmitted joiner, ADV-13 network attacker (recommend A: confirm all)
OQ-2 shared operating-system user: accept, separate users, or accept and record the option (recommend C)
OQ-3 circuit credential lifetime: 15 min, 1 h (renew from 30 min, absolute 24 h), or 4 h (recommend B)
OQ-4 same-host new conversation without the hub (J4): always via hub, local when the hub is down, or always local (recommend A: always via hub)
OQ-5 failures the durable store must survive (recommend A: process and host crash survived, the rest detected)
OQ-6 meaning of 'operator' as a sender until GP-11 is ruled (recommend A: nothing operator-class until an operator key exists)
OQ-7 content on the hub: accept now, per-project read scope, or end-to-end encryption later (recommend A now, C later)
OQ-8 fleet admission by roster, signed cards and home-hub binding (recommend A; needs the charter rewording of T-2470)
OQ-9 take the proposed numbers of section 19 as starting values (recommend A)
Accept or reject residual risks RR-1..RR-14 (section 20), one per line (the task's Human AC)
Accept or reject change requests CR-1..CR-13 to the requirements (section 21)
